gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.
The thief was ___ (ARREST) at the border.
The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: The government made a formal ___ (DECLARE) of intent to invest in rail.
gaps.explanation: 'A formal declaration' — the noun follows the adjective.
'Studying management' — the field is called management.

gaps.sentence: ___ (PERSIST) rain ruined the first two days of the festival.
gaps.explanation: An adjective is needed before 'rain': persistent; 'persistence' is the noun.
'Championship victory' — the title/contest, not the person.
